What relevant professional experience would you like to include? Share the company and job title; one employer is enough.

Prioritize 3–5 recent, relevant experiences if available; do not add jobs just to reach a count. Show architecture, technical decisions, mentoring and confirmed team impact. Use measurable achievements only when you can confirm them; a clear qualitative result is also useful.

What technical skills would you like to highlight?

Consider 8–15 relevant skills you can demonstrate; fewer are fine. Candidate skills (include only those you actually have): System design, Technical leadership, Mentoring, Python, Machine learning, Deep learning, Natural language processing, Data preprocessing, Model evaluation, Statistics, SQL, Git, PyTorch, scikit-learn, MLOps.
